bio.text: Jubilee Underwood, a Republican, has represented District 27 in the Alaska House of Representatives since 2025.

According to the Alaska Legislature, Underwood has lived in Wasilla since age 24 (and for much of earlier life), served on a school board from 2021 to 2024 and as its president in 2023-2024, and has worked as a realtor since 2014.

The biography lists earlier jobs as an Alaska Airlines customer service agent (2005-2012) and in medical and physical therapy offices, and education as a high school diploma and a nine-month ministry school.
